bean.name: SpiffeJwtSecurityPolicy
bean.title: Spiffe Jwt Security Policy
bean.description: Validates a JWT-SVID and authorizes its SPIFFE identity before a route segment, preserving the application body. A missing, rejected or unauthorized token fails closed.

audience.description: Comma-separated audiences to validate against. A token is accepted when it validates for any configured audience. Message headers cannot override this check.

acceptedSpiffeIds.description: Comma-separated allow-list of validated SPIFFE identities to authorize. Set exactly one of acceptedSpiffeIds and acceptAnySpiffeId.

acceptAnySpiffeId.description: Authorize any SPIFFE identity whose JWT-SVID validates for a configured audience, leaving further authorization to a downstream policy. Mutually exclusive with acceptedSpiffeIds.

spiffeSocketPath.label: security
spiffeSocketPath.description: Path to the Workload API endpoint. Defaults to the spiffeSocketPath of the spiffe component, then to the SPIFFE_ENDPOINT_SOCKET environment variable. Ignored when a workloadApiClient is used.

workloadApiClient.label: advanced
workloadApiClient.description: An existing WorkloadApiClient to use. Defaults to the client of the spiffe component, when it has one. The client remains owned by its supplier and is not closed when the guarded route stops.
